description: This PHP class 'PayGrade' extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable' to handle filtering by pay grade in an HRM report. It includes methods to modify query builders based on pay grade, retrieve entity aliases, and convert pay grade IDs to array representations with labels.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: Represents a filter field for PayGrade in report filtering, allowing addition of where conditions, entity alias retrieval, and conversion of pay grade IDs to labels.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder to filter by pay grade if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias 'salary' used in query context.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves the pay grade entity and returns an array with its ID and name, or null if not found.
